messages:
maya: Idea - add named presets to the rollout fallback panel so teams can pick 'safe' defaults instead of tuning low-level knobs every time.

owen: Curious which knobs we bake into presets. error_rate_threshold, degrade_mode (soft/hard), sample_pct, and audit_ttl?

maya: Yep those. Also show the expanded policy JSON inline and a tiny explanation blurb per preset.

ana: +1 but add transparency: show the live sim result for the last 1k requests (estimate) when you switch presets. Tag it as an approximation.

kevin: Ops constraints: any manual override must capture an operator note and an expiry. Overrides should be visible in the rollout's audit trail.

owen: UX: when switching presets show a one-line KPI delta (est fallback %, est cost delta, est p95 change). Example: "Conservative -> Balanced: +0.4% fallback, -5% cost".

maya: On the simulation: run a fast in-browser sim (1k traces) first; if the policy needs historical traces, schedule a background sim job and show status.

ana: Telemetry plan: emit event `rb.rollout_applied` with fields: source=preset|explicit, preset_name, patch_overrides, operator, sim_estimate. Also mark sampled requests with `rb_policy.source` and `rb_policy.version`.

kevin: API proposal: keep a single object `degradation_config` with shape {source, preset?, overrides?}. Server resolves to full `fallback_policy` and stores the canonical snapshot. If both preset and explicit policy supplied, explicit wins.

owen: Small API example: 
```json
{
  "target":"svc/complete:prod",
  "degradation_config": {"source":"preset","preset":"balanced","overrides":{"error_rate":"0.08"}}
}
```

maya: Need UI affordance to "reveal resolved policy" and "revert to previous policy". Revert should create a new rollout version, not mutate history.

ana: For audits include a compact `policy_snapshot` (canonical JSON) and `diff_from_previous` string. Also store sim snapshot so postmortems can replay.

kevin: Gate: disallow creating aggressive presets on prod without 2 approvals. UI should gray it out unless approver flow done.

ops-bot: Created INF-4402: "named fallback presets + sim + audit" assigned to eng-platform.

maya: Can someone prototype the preset tooltip copy? Short bullets only.

owen: Draft: "Conservative: immediate small fallback to maintain latency. Balanced: fewer fallbacks, slightly higher p95. Aggressive: delay fallback; may increase error surface."

ana: I'll add telemetry field definitions to the PR and an example `rb.rollout_applied` event.

kevin: One more: emit metric `rb.preset_switch.count` tagged by preset_from/preset_to and whether overrides were applied.

maya: Great. I'll add this thread to the rollout design doc and ask design to sketch the diff preview.

owen: I'll open the API + mock PR after lunch. Thanks everyone!
